_note: PRODUCTION config for the full 204-country byProduct NTL export. Run: npm run batch -- --config config/config.production-ntl.json  (see docs/FRIEND_SETUP_GUIDE.md). To retry only the failures: add --retry-failed. byProduct + Detail=NTL + source=direct (Mirror is disabled for byProduct) + dataType=QUANTITIES (not values). Files, manifest and report are quantities-specific ({dataTypeWord} in the name + latest-run-ntl-quantities.json / run-report-ntl-quantities.xlsx) so a quantities run never mixes with or overwrites a values run. Full list = countries-full.xlsx (204). SPEED vs BLOCK: speedProfile picks the anti-block pause cadence — 'safe' (slowest, safest), 'balanced' (default, ~45s-2.5min pauses), 'fast' (fewer/shorter pauses, HIGHER block risk). Change ONLY this one word to go faster; if the account ever gets blocked, set it back to 'safe'. The real bottleneck is Trade Map building the heavy NTL tables server-side (~minutes each), NOT the throttle. finalRetryRounds=3: after the main pass, any FAILED country is queued and retried up to 3 more times at the end (still throttled). NTL tables are heavy: dataReadyTimeoutMs=15min, download timeoutMs=10min. Own resume manifest; re-running the SAME command resumes where it left off.
